90: ### M1 (Local Proxy) ↔ M4/M5 (Frontend Client)
91: - **Base URL**: `http://127.0.0.1:8088` (or dynamic port detected at startup)
92: - **`GET /health`**:
93:   - Response: `{"status": "ok", "uptime": number, "version": "1.0.0"}`
94: - **`GET /api/servers`**:
95:   - Response: `{"servers": [{"name": "secret", "4k": true}, {"name": "Nebula", "4k": false}, ...]}`
96: - **`GET /api/stream`**:
97:   - Query parameters:
98:     - `tmdbId`: string (e.g. `"27205"`)
99:     - `type`: `"movie"` | `"tv"`
100:     - `season`: string (optional, for tv)
101:     - `episode`: string (optional, for tv)
102:     - `server`: string (optional, defaults to `"secret"`)
103:   - Response (JSON):
104:     ```json
105:     {
106:       "success": true,
107:       "streamUrl": "http://127.0.0.1:8088/hls/proxy?url=https%3A%2F%2Flightspeed.st%2Fhls%2F...%2Fmaster.m3u8",
108:       "originalUrl": "https://lightspeed.st/hls/.../master.m3u8",
109:       "server": "secret",
110:       "subtitles": [
111:         {"label": "English", "srclang": "en", "src": "http://127.0.0.1:8088/proxy/sub?url=..."}
112:       ]
113:     }
114:     ```
115: - **`GET /hls/proxy?url={encodedUrl}`**:
116:   - Forwards request to target with headers `Origin: https://cinejoy.pk` and `Referer: https://cinejoy.pk/`.
117:   - For `.m3u8` playlists: Rewrites internal relative and absolute URIs to point back through `/hls/proxy?url=...`.
118:   - For `.png` / `.mp4` chunks: Streams binary chunks with `Content-Type: video/mp4` and `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`.

121: - **Navigable Attribute**: Elements declare `data-nav="true"`, `data-nav-group="{groupName}"`, `data-nav-index="{index}"`.
122: - **Focus Class**: `.focused` added by `SpatialNav.setFocus(element)`.
123: - **Events**:
124:   - `onSelect(element)`: Triggered on Enter / OK key (keycode 13).
125:   - `onBack()`: Triggered on Back key (keycode 461 or 27). Returns boolean (true if handled, false to allow system back).
